notes:
Initial qualification for Private VPC deployment. Enterprise finance use case: high-volume transaction vetting + post-trade surveillance. Very sensitive PII and transaction metadata; must meet EU residency for EU customers and Fed/NYDFS constraints for US operations.

Key asks from call:
- Customer-managed KMS (BYOK) + HSM-backed keys. Wants KMS in their AWS account.
- Full audit trail: CloudTrail-style logs sent to their Splunk instance; 7-year retention for select logs.
- No inbound internet to model servers; strict egress controls.
- Regional isolation: prod EU (eu-west-1), prod US (us-east-1), DR in us-west-2.
- Support for transit gateway / cross-account peering; prefer central security VPC pattern.

Quote from CISO: "We will not accept vendor-held keys for production PII processing."

AE notes: strong exec buy-in; procurement timeline aggressive if security answers are satisfactory. Prefers canary rollout; must pass penetration test and NFRs before go-live.

vpc_architecture_summary: Proposed topology: dedicated model VPC per region with private subnets for model compute; NAT Gateway or managed egress proxies in central ops VPC. Control-plane egress limited to TLS on 443 to specific Redwood endpoints; prefer VPC endpoint (interface) or S3 gateway endpoints for model artifact pulls. Cross-account Transit Gateway preferred for multi-account isolation. No public IPs on model nodes; load balancers only for internal ALB use between services.
kms_and_key_management: Customer wants BYOK: keys provisioned in customer AWS account (KMS CMKs) and option for HSM attestation. Key rotation policy must be supported. Redwood to support KMS envelope encryption for artifacts and runtime token encryption. Need design doc for key usage, key-policy examples, and steps for emergency key rotation / failover.
audit_logging_and_monitoring: Requirement: all API calls, model request metadata (non-content), control-plane changes logged and forwarded to customer's Splunk. CloudTrail + VPC flow logs + application logs aggregated; retention SLA 7 years for compliance events. Must provide signed log delivery proof and optional syslog/SIEM connectors. Support for audit-level export via secure SFTP or S3 with restricted access.
data_residency_and_retention: EU transactional data must remain and be processed in eu-west-1. Redwood to guarantee residency by routing requests per region; no cross-region backups for EU data unless explicitly allowed. Retention windows configurable per dataset; legal wants deletion attestations for PII and proof of deletion from caches/KV stores. Documented retention controls required for procurement.
